title: Deephome: A Telleen Adventure, The Return: Part 1

events.response:
You crawl through the tight passageway, your lantern swinging in your hand, 
casting shadows that play about all around you.  Perhaps a human would be 
claustraphobic here, certainly one of the Elves would, but you are a Dwarven 
Reclaimer, sent to explore and prepare the abandoned city for the return of its 
people.  The ancient city awaits, just a little further up.  You shuffle 
farther in until you finally see the wooden doorway that brings a large bearded 
smile to your face.  You're there!  You have finally reached...


DEEPHOME
A Telleen Adventure
 THE RETURN: PART 1

For Help type "help" and for credits type...you guessed it, "credits!"
Visit the Telleen homepage at http://www.angelfire.com/nj2/Yesuslave
All comments and suggestions should go to Joshua Wise at YesuSlave@Yahoo.com
Release 1 / Serial number 991210 / Inform v6.15 Library 6/8 

Secret Entrance
This is a rather dark and small room, having only two exits, back north the way 
you came, from the ancestral homes of Tana, or through the heavily barred 
wooden door before you that leads southwest and inward to the abandoned 
Deephome, abode of the Dwarves in Telleen.  It has been three hundred years 
since your people lived here.

The door blocks the way into the city of Deephome.

The note reads:
"Reclaimer:

You have the esteemed duty to return to our Mountain Kingdom of  Deephome and 
prepare it for our return.  There are several things a Reclaimer must do:

1.  Restore Power to the City
2.  Restore Water to the city.
3.  Visit each location and make sure it is safe, a quick appraisal should be 
sufficient. 
4.  Open the City Gates once more.  
5.  MOST IMPORTANT:  Make sure the city is SAFE to return to.  

May the Peace of Kraxis go with you

King Derash of the Mountain Tana, the year 782 SK."

>

N. Main Street

bakery to the east, and a scrivener's  to the west.  To the north is the Main 
hall, and the street runs further south.

cases.suggestion: Perform the offering sequence in one uninterrupted visit: after 'drop coin' triggers 'You feel power begin to rise around you', do NOT leave the room or let an intermediate command fail — each following step (pour water, put ashes, put clover) should produce escalating power feedback. If a step gives only a flat/inert acknowledgment (e.g., pour printing just 'You pour the water on The Gold Coin' with no power reaction), the ritual flag was invalidated; restore a checkpoint or re-do the whole sequence cleanly.
cases.notes: In the failed run (branch b4), the first 'pour water on coin' failed with 'You can't see any thing' because the bottle was in another room (e00535), and the player then left the Temple to fetch it. All later steps parsed and printed ordinary success lines, and 'drop coin' still re-fired 'power begin to rise' (e00567), but 'manaz' fizzled three times (e00555, e00559, e00569). In the clean run (branch b5, e00589-e00594) the same commands produced escalating ritual feedback at every step — 'you feel the power grow. The Dark Spirit writhes in anger' (pour, e00590), 'power pulsing' (ashes, e00591), 'air becomes thick with power' (clover, e00592) — and 'manaz' banished Indanaz for +30 (e00594). Establishes that parser success is not ritual success: the game tracks an unstated uninterrupted-sequence state, and intermediate failure/leaving the room silently voids it while commands still appear to work. Limitation: whether leaving the room alone (without the failed pour) voids the state was not isolated; both factors co-occurred in the failed run.
